messages:
acme-runner: Hey team, hitting a reproducible issue when streaming JSON from Redwood: the final object arrives truncated (last key/value cut mid-value). Our app throws a parse error in production.

acme-runner: Quick repro with curl (we're calling /v1/streams):
```
curl -i -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \  \
  -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \  \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/generate?mode=json
```

acme-runner: Last chunk we get ends like `..., \"user_metadata\": \"env=prod,role=adm` and then connection closes. No closing brace.

maya: Sorry for the trouble — can you confirm the edge/proxy chain? Any Cloudflare/NGINX or internal h2 proxy in front? Also did you see any 5xx or TCP resets?

acme-runner: We run behind our infra team’s HTTP/2 proxy (h2proxy) and Cloudflare. No 5xx, just EOF on the socket. Repro on both curl and our live client.

kevin: cc @sam (eng-runtime) — this looks like an early FIN/truncation on keepalive window. Have you checked if the proxy is sending a RST_STREAM or HPACK error?

sam: Thanks — can you grab a tcpdump of the connection and the chunk boundaries? Also helpful: our request_id from response headers if available (we log x-rw-request-id).

acme-runner: Attached header we captured: `x-rw-request-id: rw-abc123` and `via: h2proxy/1.0, cloudflare`

acme-runner: Pasted minimal tcpdump excerpt (annotated):
```
[TCP FIN from proxy] seq 12345 ack 67890 
[TLS app data - final SSE chunk] ... 0x7b 0x22 75 73 65 72 5f 6d 65 74 61 64 61 74 61 22 3a 20 22 65 6e 76 3d 70 72 6f 64 2c 72 6f 6c 65 3d 61 64 6d 
[Connection closed]
```

maya: That looks like the TCP FIN is cutting off the last bytes. We'll escalate — @sam can you check server-side SSE chunking and keepalive timers, plus whether we flush the final chunk before closing?

sam: On it. Initial hypothesis: the SSE writer may be flushing while the http2 stream is still open, then an intermediate proxy is closing the stream before the final flush completes. Will check commit that touched chunk flushing (runtime commit f2d9b3).

sam: Meanwhile, can you set your client to tolerate partial final chunk and attempt reconnect to resume? As temporary workaround: request `Connection: keep-alive` and add a tiny tail whitespace to force final frame to send fully.

acme-runner: Trying patch now (client retries + keepalive). Will report back within 30m. Thanks. :pray:

deploy-bot: deploy 2368.123 applied to runtime-flush-fix-candidate — rollout to canary (10%) started by @sam.

kevin: Noted. If we confirm truncation caused by proxy, we should add a runtime defensive: buffer last chunk until ACK/flush confirmed or send explicit final sentinel token (e.g., `__STREAM_END__`) so parsers don't fail.

maya: I'll keep this prioritized on support side and update the customer. If acme-runner confirms fixed with client changes, we'll keep the canary and monitor x-rw-request-id traces for truncation events.

acme-runner: Quick update — client retry + keepalive eliminated the parse errors for ~200 requests. Still seeing ~1/1000 truncated, will follow up with tcpdump when it occurs. Thanks team.
